label: Every GOD_4 exists at w and has power for there being no contingent concrete being
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation, unattributed): every GOD_4 exists at w and has at w a power (PowerFor) for there being no contingent concrete being (NoContingentConcreteIn): the world-level total-noncreation power (TOTAL_REFRAINING_2). As typed it is independent of 0050b6ed (joint absence of the actual contingents): neither entails the other without Euclidean access and monotone powers. Motivation, navigation only: on classical theism God could have refrained from creating (ST I q.19 a.3). It does not exclude necessary concreta and says nothing about which creatures exist otherwise.
